Mia (support): Customer on Dedicated complaining: JSON mode / function call payloads keep 400ing with "invalid JSON in tool args" when calling our payments tool. They say it used to work last week. Attaching example from their logs.

Sanjay (support): Can you paste the raw request / response? need request_id and model/version. Also is customer pinned to a model variant?

Mia (support): request_id=rc_9f3a21, model=gpt-4o-redwood:2026-03-01 (pinned). Raw response excerpt from LLM returned in `tool_call` -> `arguments`:
```json
"{\"user\":{\"id\":\"123\",\"address\":\"{\\\"line1\\\":\\\"123 Main\\\",\\\"city\\\":\\\"Oak\\\"}\"}}"
```
-> The whole `arguments` value is a JSON string (double-encoded). Our parser tries to parse as JSON object and fails because it sees a string. Error in platform logs: `JSON.parse error: Unexpected token " in JSON at position 0` at parseToolArgs.

Alex (eng-runtime): That looks like classic double-encoding: model emitted a stringified JSON inside the `arguments` field instead of an object. Do we have a tolerant pre-parse to attempt JSON.parse if value is string? Logs for rc_9f3a21 show parseToolArgs -> throw -> 400 returned to customer.

Jess (eng-ml): Noted. We saw a recent regen of the fine-tuned policy for this model family that tightened the tool-calling examples. Some examples in the prompt templates include "arguments": "{...}" by mistake. Could be a prompt regression causing the model to wrap args in quotes.

Mia (support): Customer on a live rollout, says failures ~10% of calls and they hit production errors. They want a mitigation and then a fix.

Sanjay (support): Escalating to eng-runtime. Want a mitigation that doesn't change customer behavior. Prefer server-side tolerant parsing + a short-term config flag to accept stringified args.

Alex (eng-runtime): I'll add tolerant parsing: if `arguments` is a string, attempt JSON.parse once; if it still fails, fallback to returning schema-validation error but keep original error semantics for other cases. Will push a canary and a feature flag. Also will add logging metric `tool_args_double_encoded`.

Alex (eng-runtime): Quick repro (run locally against staging):
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{
    "model":"gpt-4o-redwood",
    "mode":"json",
    "input":"call payments.create",
    "tool_schema": {"name":"payments.create","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"user":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"address":{"type":"object"}}},"amount":{"type":"number"}}}
  }'
```
Then simulate the model returning "arguments": "{...}" in the `tool_call` block. Observe parser error before the patch.

Jess (eng-ml): We'll roll back the prompt examples that introduced the quoted-args formatting and add a unit test that model samples for tool-calls produce JSON objects (not stringified JSON).

Alex (eng-runtime): Plan: (1) deploy tolerant-parser behind flag (canary on 5% traffic) within 12h, (2) expose flag to Dedicated customers for immediate enabling, (3) eng-ml to roll prompt fix + tests, (4) monitor `tool_args_double_encoded` metric and customer error rate.

support-bot: Ticket updated: assigned to #eng-runtime, priority=P1, linked request_id=rc_9f3a21.

Mia (support): Thanks — I'll notify the customer that we have a short-term mitigation and will follow up when the canary is up. :thumbsup:

Sanjay (support): Also noting billing: calls that error still consumed tokens; ops, can we credit for rc_9f3a21's failed calls while we investigate?

Alex (eng-runtime): I'll ask finance/ops. For now we should definitely credit while we confirm incidence. I'll post the PR link when ready.

Mia (support): Adding final note: customer said one of their integrators had been sending `address` as a single-line string in previous weeks, so we may need schema relaxation for backwards compatibility (address: string OR object). Jess, can you confirm if prompt fix will still allow that?

Jess (eng-ml): We'll make the prompt produce proper objects; for schema compatibility, consider a small server-side migration to accept string for `address` and coerce into `{"line1": value}` if simple. We'll add that to follow-up tasks.

Alex (eng-runtime): OK creating the canary patch now. Will update thread with PR and canary status.
